chunks: When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, died, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said: ‘We grieved for you, O Ibrahim, and indeed we are patient. The heart grieves, and the eye sheds tears, but we do not say that which angers the Lord.’

key_terms.لَصَابِرُونَ: Certainly steadfast and patient in affliction

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say when his son Ibrahim died?
ai.summary: This hadith relates the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله expression of grief at the death of his son Ibrahim while affirming patience and restraint. It shows that sorrow and tears are natural, but a believer must avoid words that displease Allah.
